# Security

Dots Phone is an experimental, self-hosted preview. Security fixes target the
latest published preview; update the service and installed plugin together.
Earlier versions do not have a separate maintenance branch.

Use [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/gabeosx/dot-phone-plugin/security/advisories/new)
to contact the maintainer privately. Include the affected version, impact and a
minimal reproduction using fictional data. Do not submit working credentials,
real phone numbers, call recordings, transcripts or raw runtime files. Keep
security reports out of public issues. Response times are best effort.

If private reporting is temporarily unavailable, open a public issue requesting
a private contact method without disclosing the vulnerability or private data.

Keep the service behind the documented authentication and tunnel setup, preserve
dry-run mode until ready to authorize a call, and keep credentials and encryption
keys outside source control. See [privacy and data handling](../docs/PRIVACY.md)
and [operations](../docs/RUNBOOK.md) for deployment details.
